verdict.rationale: Canva's first-party REST API docs state that Canva provides an OpenAPI description of the REST APIs, usable with openapi-generator to produce client SDKs. That directly meets the machine-readable spec story. The probe's 404s only cover guessed conventional paths, so they don't contradict the documented claim. missing for 10: an evidenced download URL or location for the spec, independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec is retrievable, and detail on spec version and coverage (e.g. whether it includes the Admin and SCIM APIs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Canva provides an OpenAPI description of the REST APIs. You can use this with code generation libraries, such as [openapi-generator](https://github.com/OpenAPITools/openapi-generator), to generate client SDKs in various languages.
